semiconductor_relevance: Medium — the company is developing innovative composite materials that could have applications in electronics, including potential semiconductor functionalities.
summary: Yokohama National University's Oya Laboratory is focused on developing carbon nanotube (CNT) composite materials, specifically CNT composite paper and yarn. These materials leverage traditional Japanese techniques and aim to integrate functionalities such as transistors and thermoelectric power generation into paper and fabric formats.
capabilities: Development of carbon nanotube composite paper
Creation of thermoelectric power generation elements from paper
Integration of CNTs into traditional textile materials

regional_presence.Japan: The laboratory is based in Japan and utilizes traditional Japanese techniques in its material development.
